items.title: Xylem raises annual profit forecast as AI growth lifts demand for water-treatment equipment
items.summary: Xylem on Tuesday raised its 2026 profit forecast after its second-quarter results ‌beat Wall Street estimates, as cost savings and ‌price increases boosted profitability amid strengthening AI infrastructure demand. Shares of ​the company rose more than 2% in premarket trading. The water-management company now expects 2026 adjusted earnings of $5.55 to $5.70 per share, compared with its previous forecast of $5.35 ‌to $5.60 per share.
